question: What is the capital city of France?
output_text:
• Paris is the capital and largest city of France, located in the north-central part of the country on the Seine River in the Île-de-France region [1, 3, 6]

• Paris is nicknamed the "City of Light" (ville lumière), mainly due to its leading role in the Age of Enlightenment [3]

• The city has a population of approximately 2.04 million within the city proper, with a metropolitan population of around 13.3 million [3]

• Paris became the capital of France in 508 under King Clovis, and retrieved its capital status under King Philippe Auguste (1180-1223), remaining the capital until today except for a brief interruption during German occupation in World War II (1940-1944) [5]

• Paris is famous for iconic landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and is recognized as a world center for art, fashion, cuisine, and culture [1, 2, 4]

Final answer: The capital city of France is **Paris**.
final_answer: The capital city of France is **Paris**.
